name: Yume Ori ~Yume o Tsugu Mono~
source:
An original pure love adventure game for adults only. 

Follow along in three episodes of dream creation, yarning and experiencing. 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE067069.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款僅限成人的原創純愛冒險遊戲，分為三個章節，講述夢境的創造、追尋與體驗。

[來源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE067069.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
